baseline: B0 image accident-region detector; one accident region per event per frame
representation: axis-aligned envelope of visible original GT boxes of all reviewed event participants in the current frame
temporal_extent: only the reviewed Colliding interval, inclusive source frame indices
participant_selection: explicit reviewed event GT IDs; never inferred solely from spatial overlap or global Colliding IDs
outside_participant_policy: skip candidate; record unknown, never export empty negative label
missing_annotation_policy: preserve missing status; no implied negative or interpolated box
occluded_participant_policy: keep original box/flag in proposal, require region review; never infer hidden extent
separator_policy: exclude from objects and candidates; retain in audit for shot-boundary review
negative_policy: no empty labels unless whole scene/frame is explicitly certified negative for the task
coordinate_convention: original VATIC xyxy; normalized width=(xmax-xmin)/image_width, no invented +1 correction
